plan.title: Knockout auction rejects a second bidding currency

steps.note: Start on the single-stage creation path.
Allow vendors to be added during creation.
Create the RFQ prerequisite for a supported Knockout conversion.
Supply a unique title so missing-title validation cannot interfere.
Add the specified product and quantity.
Invite two available QA vendors without inventing company names.
Reach the conversion screen where Knockout is available.
Select Knockout on the converted auction.

args.goal: In the converted Knockout auction configuration, add a second bidding currency different from the default and complete any other required Knockout configuration with valid values; stop on the create screen showing the second currency configured.

steps.note: Configure the currency condition through the buyer UI without guessing control labels.
Commit the converted auction's Start now schedule for 30 minutes.
Complete remaining mandatory fields so unrelated omissions do not cause the refusal.

args.because: Currency configuration cannot be added in Knockout / Dutch Auction

steps.note: Attempt publication and require the exact currency-and-strategy refusal.
